signals.summary: Indoor gardeners showing off rare blooms and rooms overtaken by foliage — orchids spiking, pothos climbing walls, propagations that beat the odds.
signals.why_now: Ten independent r/houseplants posts within ~20h: a rescued cutting that 'bloomed for the first time' (1.2h), '25 blooms in one night... the neighbors can smell it' (7.3h), 'Ruth Begonia Ginsburg — how it's going' (10.2h), 'My mirror pothos is taking over' (11.4h), 'It has begun' (19.3h) and 'Psychopsis in bloom... third spike' (19.8h).

signals.summary: A vintage-forward decorating mood — grandparents' pieces, gingham, and 'newstalgia' warmth — pitched by design press as the next big interior direction.
signals.why_now: Multiple design outlets within ~50h: 'Joanna Gaines' Living Room is a Masterclass in Newstalgia... Trend of 2027' (49.3h), '7 Things Your Grandparents Decorated With That Designers Now Love' (44.8h), '10 Home Trends That Make Your Space Look Older' (6.9h) and 'Going Gingham: checked interiors' in Vogue (18.3h).

signals.summary: Clever compact homes — lofted beds, extra-wide tiny houses and narrow city apartments — styled to prove small can be complete.
signals.why_now: Independent items within ~40h: 'Extra-wide tiny house makes more space for family living' (11.1h), 'These 10 Lofted Bedrooms Are the Blueprint for Small-Space Living' (39.3h) and NeverTooSmall's 'Long, Narrow Seoul Apartment' (40.3h), alongside a steady run of r/malelivingspace first-apartment setups.
